name: What is filling the disk
description: Filesystem usage, then the 20 largest directories under a path you choose.
author: voltius

snippets.name: What is filling the disk
snippets.description: Read-only — it reports, it never deletes.

steps.content:
ROOT="{{path}}"

df -h -x tmpfs -x devtmpfs
echo
echo "Largest directories under $ROOT:"
OUT=$(sudo du -h -x --max-depth=3 -- "$ROOT" | sort -rh | head -20)
if [ -n "$OUT" ]; then
  echo "$OUT"
else
  echo "Nothing found under $ROOT (path may not exist, or sudo failed)."
fi
